paper_id: Li et al. - 2008 - Signature-File-Based Approach for Query Answering Over Wireless Sensor Networks
title: Signature-File-Based Approach for Query Answering Over Wireless Sensor Networks
motivation: 传感器节点电池供电、难以更换，需节省能耗；同时无线链路丢包率高达30%，需抗损
problem_framing: 在节能与抗丢包约束下，同时支持聚合查询和范围查询两类应用
key_insight: 签名文件的叠加编码天然去重(OR操作)+可压缩+误报率可精确控制，实现节能与鲁棒性兼得
method_signature: 签名文件+多径路由+自适应RLE压缩+动态桶分配
evaluation_criteria: 查询精度(召回率)和通信开销(包数)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Sketch方法仅支持聚合查询，且在节点稀疏时偏差过大精度极低；等宽桶在非均匀分布下导致bucket竞争误差
evidence_for_taste: only works on aggregative queries, which is thus infeasible for range queries
the accuracy of the sketch approach is based on the large number of nodes
possible excessive bias on the sketch insert may lead to very low accuracy
The LIST approach's performance is the worst
may introduce large errors when data distribution does not follow the uniform distribution
thinking_moves: 把multipath的去重难题归约到签名文件的位运算OR操作
发现签名文件稀疏性(0多1少)，用改进RLE压缩降低传输开销
用false drop公式反推签名长度m和权重w，实现误差率可精确控制
识别Sketch仅支持聚合的局限，将边界查询能力作为自己的核心优势
